references.authors: Mosallanejad K, Hubeau C, Schwartz Sterman A, Tan Y
references.claim: Bi-directional crosstalk between macrophages and heterogeneous fibroblast populations drives maladaptive repair and fibrotic remodeling under sustained inflammatory conditions.
references.contribution: This proposal adds a concrete perturbation experiment with a directionality index to test the direction of signaling in fibroblast-macrophage cocultures, which the review does not establish.
references.limitation: This is a review article and does not provide original experimental data on the direction of signaling in fibroblast-macrophage cocultures.
references.title: Macrophages and the Tissue Repair Circuit: Homeostasis, Autoimmune Diseases, and Resolution-Based Therapeutic Strategies

references.authors: Fatehi Hassanabad A, Sinha S, Jaffer A, et al.
references.claim: Human pericardial immune cells directly inhibit cardiac fibroblast fibrotic activity, and fibronectin-expressing human pericardial macrophages are the primary driver of the pericardial antifibrotic actions through the release of cystatin C.
references.contribution: This proposal adds a concrete perturbation experiment to test the direction of signaling in fibroblast-macrophage cocultures, which the study does not establish.
references.limitation: This study focuses on pericardial macrophages and cardiac fibrosis, and does not establish the direction of signaling in fibroblast-macrophage cocultures.
references.title: Human pericardial macrophages suppress cardiac fibrosis through cystatin C signaling after myocardial infarction

references.authors: Huang J, Yin X, Shi X, et al.
references.claim: Dysplastic megakaryocytes coordinate stromal, immune, and endothelial responses to drive fibrotic progression, and release or activate TGF-beta1, platelet factor 4, and other profibrotic mediators that interact with stromal, immune, and endothelial cells.
references.contribution: This proposal adds a concrete perturbation experiment to test the direction of signaling in fibroblast-macrophage cocultures, which the review does not establish.
references.limitation: This is a review article and does not provide original experimental data on the direction of signaling in fibroblast-macrophage cocultures.
references.title: Megakaryocytes in myelofibrosis: mechanisms of fibrotic niche remodeling and therapeutic implications
